verdict.rationale: doola documents a per-company compliance calendar listing the recurring obligations it tracks to keep a company in good standing, plus annual report filing it can follow through to completion. That covers deadlines and standing-related obligations for individual entities. The evidence does not show a single dashboard that aggregates every entity and every state registration with its current standing. The only dashboard mentioned is for registered-agent mail, and the calendar is exposed per company through the API. missing for 10: a unified multi-entity dashboard view, per-state registration and good-standing status display, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
